heading: About Me
paragraphs: Sudipta Saha holds a Master’s degree in Information Technology from La Trobe University. This academic background has provided him with a robust foundation in technology, allowing him to excel in the field of IT consulting.

As a certified SAP Development Associate specializing in SAP BTP Extension Development, Sudipta has cultivated expertise in delivering innovative solutions. Leveraging the SAP Cloud Application Programming Model, he is adept at contributing to projects requiring technical excellence and cutting-edge solutions.
Explore my resume and portfolio to learn more about my skills, experience, and the professional journey that drives my work.
